notes.title: Yarn Guardians — Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Today we fly. Five fearless, flying cats, yarn-powered abilities, and a hand-drawn world await you — available now on Steam.[/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you to:
• The community — for wishlists, playtests, feedback, and endless encouragement.
• Creators — for streams, videos, and sharing cozy chaos with your audiences.
• The devs at Pentapaw Studios — for the craft, care, and magic that made this world real.[/p][p]We hope you have a great time playing — and we’re excited to read your honest reviews![/p]

notes.title: Release Update: Yarn Guardians Launch Moved to August 14, 2025
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, We have a small update: [i]Yarn Guardians[/i] will now launch on [b]August 14[/b].[/p][p]The reason? We're still finishing up localization, and we want [b]everyone around the world[/b] to have the [b]same great experience[/b] on day one – no matter which language they play in.[/p][p]The game is nearly done (and we're really proud of it!), but a few final touches are still in the works.[/p][p]The [b]demo is still live on Steam[/b], so feel free to jump in while you wait![/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support – it means the world to us. – The Yarn Guardians Team [/p]

notes.title: YARN GUARDIANS – PLAYTEST STARTS TODAY!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027573/eb6fa47ee5c4dcf778bc10a257c950ae39fdb5d2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🧶✨ [b]The 2nd Steam Playtest is live – and you’re invited![/b] ✨🧶[/p][p]From [b]today until Monday (included!)[/b], you can jump into the cozy chaos of [i]Yarn Guardians[/i] – completely FREE on Steam![/p][p]🐾 Play as one of five flying cats

notes.title: Yarn Guardians Goes to Indie Game Fest 2025!
notes.content:
[p]Hi Yarn Guardians![/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that [i]Yarn Guardians[/i] will be featured at [b]Indie Game Fest 2025[/b] in [b]Cologne[/b], Germany! 😺🧵
Come visit us at the [b]Wasserturm Hotel Cologne[/b] on [b]July 11 & 12[/b] to try out the latest demo, chat with the devs, and maybe even win some exclusive goodies![/p][p]You’ll be able to play solo, try local co-op, and experience the world of Rudy and the magical Yarn Balls in person.[/p][p]🎮 Play the game
🎁 Get giveaways
💬 Talk to us – we’re friendly![/p][p]📍 [b]Indie Game Fest[/b]
🗓️ [b]July 11–12, 2025[/b]
🏨 [b]Wasserturm Hotel Cologne[/b]
🔗 More info: [url="https://indiegamefest.de"]https://indiegamefest.de[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’d love to meet you![/p]

notes.title: Playtest (June 2025) Feedback
notes.content: [p]🧶✨ THANK YOU FOR PLAYING THE YARN GUARDIANS PLAYTEST! ✨🧶[/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]First of all: THANK YOU so much for playing the Yarn Guardians Open Beta and joining Rudy and his friends on their first adventure! Seeing your streams, videos and reactions has truly warmed our hearts (and our yarn balls).[/p][p][/p][p]Now, we need your help one more time:[/p][p]👉 Tell us what you think![/p][p]What did you love? What felt weird or frustrating? Did you run into bugs?[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback will help us polish the game and make Yarn Guardians the cozy, chaotic adventure we all want it to be.[/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to be honest and detailed – we read everything and appreciate every single comment.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you haven’t already:[/p][p]✅ Add Yarn Guardians to your Steam Wishlist[/p][p]✅ Join our Discord for more sneak peeks, giveaways and dev chats![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey.[/p][p]You’re all amazing Yarn Guardians already! 🐱💫🧶[/p][p][/p][p]— The Yarn Guardians Team[/p]
